name: gaincraft
description: Customer health for small B2B: aggregate usage (no per-person data), contracts, support signals, an explainable 0-100 score, calls to action, renewals, churn audit.

tools.name: gain_status
tools.description: Active accounts, ARR, telemetry days, open CTAs, signals, health weights.

tools.name: gain_account_add
tools.description: Add a customer account.

tools.name: gain_account_list
tools.description: Accounts with ARR, seats, contract dates.

tools.name: gain_account_show
tools.description: One account with health components, trend, signals, open CTAs and triage.

tools.name: gain_account_update
tools.description: Change account fields; active=false retires an account with a churn date.

tools.name: gain_telemetry_import
tools.description: Import usage aggregates per account and day; per-person columns are refused.

tools.name: gain_usage_pull
tools.description: Pull aggregate usage straight from a SQLite product database (read-only SELECT); same privacy guard.

tools.name: gain_signal_add
tools.description: Record a customer signal by hand.

tools.name: gain_health
tools.description: Health score of one account; stores a snapshot and raises CTAs.

tools.name: gain_health_all
tools.description: Health of all active accounts, worst first, ARR at risk.

tools.name: gain_triage_set
tools.description: Advisory modifier 0.8-1.2 with a reason and an expiry.

tools.name: gain_cta_list
tools.description: Open calls to action, due first.

tools.name: gain_cta_resolve
tools.description: Resolve or dismiss a CTA with a note.

tools.name: gain_deadlines
tools.description: Notice deadlines and term ends within N days.

tools.name: gain_weights
tools.description: Show or set the health weights.

tools.name: gain_inbox_drain
tools.description: Apply contract and signal events from the other craft apps.

tools.name: gain_demo_seed
tools.description: Fill an empty database with three labelled demo accounts.

tools.name: gain_cta_add
tools.description: Create a call to action by hand.

tools.name: gain_export
tools.description: Write the health report as CSV or Markdown.

tools.name: gain_backup
tools.description: Copy the whole database to a new file.

tools.name: gain_churn_audit
tools.description: Who is at risk and why, and a backtest of retired accounts.
